title: Cyrus and the Cipher
author: August Oyelaran
blurb: Mirabel Almeida, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
